besluite.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two full clauses ('Tumelo se ore het warm geword' / 'hy het na sy skoene gekyk').
besluite.rede: Two clauses with their own subject and verb; the comma is required and nothing else changes.

besluite.fout: 'en ... steeds' leaves the contrast between knowing what to do and it not feeling easy loosely linked.
besluite.rede: Same person, same two facts, same concession already carried by 'steeds'; 'maar' only makes the link explicit and the comma follows AWS.

besluite.fout: The repeated 'hy het' in one short sentence with the same subject reads wooden.
besluite.rede: Dropping the repeated subject and auxiliary is what a fluent writer would write, and the actions and their order are unchanged.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two full clauses, each with 'niemand' as subject and its own verb.
besluite.rede: Required comma between two complete clauses; meaning untouched.

besluite.fout: 'aan gestap' splits the participle of the circumposition verb (agter iemand aanstap), which is written as one word.
besluite.rede: Spelling fix only: 'agter Tumelo aangestap' is the standard written form with the same meaning.

besluite.fout: 'Die laaste ruk' is ambiguous here: it can mean 'lately' (against last year) or 'the last part of this afternoon's game'.
besluite.rede: The proposal fixes a real ambiguity but settles it on one reading, so the writer should choose the time phrase rather than a language agent.
'vinniger uitasem raak' is ordinary idiomatic Afrikaans, so 'gouer' is a lateral swap in a story.
'Die aand' already reads naturally as 'that evening' in a narrative, so the change is lateral.

besluite.fout: 'dat sy bly is hy het vertel' mixes a dat-clause with main-clause order in the next clause and makes the reader stumble.
besluite.rede: Same words and same meaning in correct, smoother word order.
'hom gegroet soos altyd' is natural Afrikaans, and moving 'soos altyd' is a lateral reordering in the story's voice.

besluite.fout: 'damp-toestel' carries a hyphen the AWS does not call for; the compound has no vowel clash and is written as one word.
besluite.rede: Plain spelling fix, applied together with changes 12 and 13 so all three occurrences stay consistent.
